snapshot.title: Example Domain
snapshot.raw_html:
Example Domain

This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.

Learn more
snapshot.summary: The main purpose of the Example Domain web page is to provide information about a hypothetical domain. The main user flow involves clicking on the "Learn more" button to access additional information or content related to the domain. Important edge cases for testing include verifying link functionality, ensuring accessibility features are in place, and confirming that the content remains consistent across different devices and browsers.

test_cases.name: Verify Learn More Button Functionality
test_cases.description: Test the functionality of the 'Learn more' button to ensure it leads to additional information or content related to the domain.

steps.target: a|Learn more| | tag=a, text='Learn more', id='', name=None, type=None, css='a'
steps.details: Click the 'Learn more' button and verify that a new page or section opens, indicating successful navigation.

test_cases.name: Check Learn More Button Accessibility
test_cases.description: Test the accessibility of the 'Learn more' button to ensure it is perceivable and operable for users with disabilities.

steps.target: a|Learn more| | tag=a, text='Learn more', id='', name=None, type=None, css='a'
steps.details: Use a screen reader to verify that the 'Learn more' button is announced correctly and can be interacted with.

test_cases.name: Verify Content Consistency Across Devices
test_cases.description: Test the consistency of content displayed on the 'Learn more' page across different devices and browsers.

steps.details: Navigate to the 'Learn more' page on multiple devices (e.g., desktop, tablet, mobile) and browsers (e.g., Chrome, Firefox), ensuring content remains consistent.

test_cases.name: Test Link Validity
test_cases.description: Ensure the link in the 'Learn more' button is valid and does not lead to a broken page or external site.

steps.target: a|Learn more| | tag=a, text='Learn more', id='', name=None, type=None, css='a'
steps.details: Check if the link associated with the 'Learn more' button is active and leads to a valid page or content.

coverage_summary: This test plan covers the basic functionality of the 'Learn more' button, including its operability and accessibility. It also includes tests for content consistency across different devices and browsers, as well as a check on the validity of the linked page.
